summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Full Stack Engineer with deep Laravel and PHP delivery experience across web apps, admin panels, integrations, testing, and deployments. Highlights should lead with your strongest stack and scope indicators, such as long-term work across Laravel, React/Vue, MySQL, Azure, and production systems

details.description: Built a business management platform covering finances, customers, contracts, payroll, and purchasing insights using Laravel 10, React 18, ChartJS, and Cypress.
Developed a construction company website and admin panel with Laravel 11 and React 18.
Delivered an employee management and internal reporting app that reduced document search and report generation time, using Laravel 11 and React 19.
Maintained and improved an event coordination platform for sellers and buyers, covering registrations and automated notifications with Laravel 8, React, Tailwind, and Inertia.
Implemented a board-based sales workflow tool with integrated chat, external service connectivity through a NodeJS/Express proxy, and deployment on Azure using React, Redux, GO.js, and Azure Chat.
Enhanced a document management frontend for creation, editing, review, and change navigation with Vue.js 2, GraphQL, TypeScript, Nuxt, Apollo, Storybook, and Cypress.
Built frontend features for an online learning platform with React, Next, and Redux Saga.
Laid out and integrated mobile app views with React Native and Styled Components.
Maintained October CMS v2 and v3 websites, adding pages, search, navigation improvements, and CSS updates.
Created an October CMS plugin for newsletter management.
Built a civil works documentation system for progress tracking, plan creation, and photo organization, reducing documentation workload by approximately 90% with Laravel 6, Vue.js 2, and Vuetify.
Developed a React Native Android app to capture work progress and photographic evidence, reducing field data collection time.
Supported and improved school materials platforms built with Laravel 5.3/5.4, JQuery, Dio, and React, deployed on Elastic Beanstalk.
Implemented features and fixes across multiple web applications, mainly with Laravel and related frontend technologies.
Automated image and video analysis with AWS Rekognition, AWS Translate, and the AWS SDK for PHP, reducing manual processing.
Created educational and support chatbots with Botpress, NodeJS, and Dialogflow.
Designed, styled, and updated WordPress websites with CSS and Bootstrap for medium and large companies.
Built a training management application for customers, instructors, courses, payments, and reports with Laravel 5.5, Vue.js 2, Vuetify, Snappy PDF, and Maatwebsite Excel.
Implemented search tools, email modules, and web features with .NET, C#, and JQuery.
Optimized SQL Server queries to improve database and application performance.
Created billing and operational modules for a multi-branch desktop application and deployed them to production.
Provided client support and resolved production application issues.
Built an operations platform for employees, payroll, construction projects, and purchases, improving project management workflows with Laravel 5.2 and Vue.js 2.
Created a construction cost estimation and documentation app that reduced preparation time by approximately 80%, built with Laravel 5.2 and Vue.js 2.
Implemented a Java Android app for field data, geolocated photos, server sync, payments, and purchase approvals, replacing manual collection processes.
Developed the corporate website with PHP and Sass, adding SEO improvements that increased organic visibility.
Updated a CodeIgniter application used to print construction plans from saved measurements.
